title: Ukutshintshwa kweSASSA Card — Indlela yokuTshintsha iKhadi eLahlekileyo, eBethweyo, okanye eNakalisiweyo
description: Inkqubo yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo yokutshintsha iSASSA card eLahlekileyo, eBethweyo, okanye eNakalisiweyo: yenzani ngokuthe ngqo, phi uhambele khona ukuthatha enye, imifuno efunekayo, iindlela, kunye nexesha lokucubungula.

seo.metaTitle: Ukutshintshwa kweSASSA Card — Inkqubo yeKhadi eLahlekileyo, eBethweyo, okanye eNakalisiweyo
seo.metaDescription: Ilahleke okanye yonakalise ikhadi yakho yeSASSA? Inkqubo yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo yokufumana enye: phi uhambele khona, imifuno ekufuneka uthwele, ithatha ixesha elingakanani, kunye indlela yokufikelela kwinqanaba lakho ngelixa ulinde.

contentBlocks.title: Ukutshintshwa kweSASSA Card — Indlela yokuTshintsha iKhadi eLahlekileyo, eBethweyo, okanye eNakalisiweyo
contentBlocks.description: Ilahleke, ibethwe, okanye yonakalise ikhadi yakho yeSASSA? Ukufumana enye kulula. Funda amanyathelo akufuneka awenze ngokuthe ngqo, apho uhambele khona, imifuno ekufuneka uthwele, kunye indlela yokufikelela kwinqanaba lakho ngelixa ulinde.

contentBlocks.text: Ukulahleka kwekhadi yakho yeSASSA okanye ukubethwa kwayo kunokuba ngumhlupheko, kodwa ukufumana enye kulula. Nantsi into ekufuneka yenziwe ngokuthe ngqo, apho uhambele khona, kunye nemifuno ekufuneka uthwele.

Ukulahleka kwekhadi yakho yokukhokelwa kunokujongeka njengokulahleka kokufikelela kuphela kwenqanaba lakho, kodwa imali yakho ayilahlekanga nangaluphi na icala — ihlala ikhuselekile kwingqinisiso yeSASSA de uyithathe. nokuba ikhadi yakho ibethwe, ilahleke ngenkqubo, okanye i-chip nje iyekile, ukutshintshwa kukutyelela iofisi eqhelekileyo. Ngelixa ulinde, kukho enye indlela esebenza ngaphandle kwekhadi.
Ukuba iKhadi yakho iLahlekile okanye iBethwe

steps.title: Yibike empoliseni (ukuba ibethwe)
steps.description: Ukuba ikhadi yakho ibethwe, bhala ingxelo yobulungisa kwisikhululo seSAPS esecaleni. Uya kudinga inombolo yesikhangiso yesicelo sakho sokutshintsha.

steps.title: Tyelela iofisi yakho yeSASSA esecaleni
steps.description: Hamba kwi-ofisi yakho yeSASSA esecaleni ngesazisi sakho. Ukuba isazisi sakho naso ibethwe, thatha ifayili evela eSAPS.

steps.title: Gcwalisa ifomu yokutshintshwa
steps.description: Umphathi weSASSA uya kukunceda ngefomu yesicelo sokutshintshwa kwekhadi. Chaza ukuba ikhadi yakho ilahlekile okanye ibethwe.

steps.title: Yamkela ikhadi yakho entsha
steps.description: Ikhadi elitshintshiweyo livame ukunikelwa ngaphakathi kweveki ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-4. Uya kwaziswa xa ilungile ukuthathwa.

contentBlocks.text: Ukuba iSASSA card yakho inakalisiwe (iphukile, igugile, okanye i-chip ayisasebenzi), tyelela iofisi yakho yeSASSA esecaleni ngesazisi kunye nekhadi elinakalisiweyo. Ukutshintshwa ngamanye amaxesha kukhawuleza kunokulahleka, kuninzi kucubungulwa ngaphakathi kweveki ezi-1 ukuya kwezi-2.
Indlela yokufikelela kwiNqanaba lakho ngelixa uLinde

Ngelixa ulinde ikhadi yakho, unokufikelela kwinqanaba lakho. Tshintsha indlela yokukhokela kuCash Send ngayo iportal yeSRD. Uya kufumana iSMS voucher onokuyisebenzisa ukuthatha inqanaba lakho kunye nayiphi na iPick n Pay, Shoprite, Boxer, Checkers, okanye iSpar ngemali.

faqs.question: Ixabiso elifanelekileyo lokutshintshwa kweSASSA card?
faqs.answer: Ukutshintshwa kokuqala kuyimahala. Ukutshintshwa okulandelayo kunokuba nemali encinci yokuphatha ngokwesigqibo seSASSA.

faqs.question: Ndingafumana inqanaba lam ngaphandle kwekhadi?
faqs.answer: Ewe. Tshintshela kuCash Send okanye ukuthunyelwa ebhankini ngelixa ulinde ikhadi yakho.

faqs.question: Ithatha ixesha elingakanani ukufumana ikhadi elitshintshiweyo?
faqs.answer: Ikhadi eLahlekileyo/eBethweyo: iiveki ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-4. Ikhadi eNakalisiweyo: iiveki ezi-1 ukuya kwezi-2.
